entities.summary: Francis Arthur Bather FRS was a British palaeontologist, geologist and malacologist. Bather was born in Richmond upon Thames. His mother, Lucy Elizabeth Blomfield, was a daughter of Charles Blomfield, Bishop of London. His father, Arthur Henry Bather, who was deaf, was a clerk in the office of the Accountant-General for the Navy.
